note: Osage County KS has zoning regulations (AG, SR, R-1, V-1 districts) and says official zoning maps may be computer records, but its public ArcGIS services (services9.arcgis.com/yGerJCngvNpaN2km: Aguse land use, parcels, city limits, soils, roads, sections) include no zoning district layer; the Community GIS viewer's config lists no zoning layer. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and of Osage City, Lyndon, Carbondale and Burlingame found no zoning district service. Only a commercial Regrid parcel dataset carries zoning fields, with about 30% coverage, so it was not submitted.
